links.comparator_used: Model without drift-triggered updating (comparator not explicitly named in the abstract)
links.outcome: Overall in-hospital mortality prediction performance (AUROC) during the COVID-19 pandemic
links.effect: Delta AUROC [SD], 0.44 [0.02]; P = .007, Mann-Whitney U test
links.quote: During the COVID-19 pandemic, drift-triggered continual learning improved overall model performance (Delta AUROC [SD], 0.44 [0.02]; P = .007, Mann-Whitney U test).

links.comparator_used: Model without transfer learning to the community hospital data (comparator not explicitly named in the abstract)
links.outcome: Mortality prediction performance (AUROC, AUPRC) at community hospitals
links.quote: Transfer learning improved model performance of community hospitals in a hospital type-dependent manner (Delta AUROC [SD], 0.05 [0.03]; Delta AUPRC [SD], 0.06 [0.04]).

links.comparator_used: No direct comparison with periodic labeled performance audits; the study measured the effect of the label-agnostic shift detection pipeline
links.outcome: Detection of harmful data shifts (age groups, admission source, hospital type, lab assays) in a mortality prediction model
links.effect: Significant data shifts were detected for younger age groups, admissions from nursing homes and acute care centers, community-to-academic hospital transfers, and changes in brain natriuretic peptide and D-dimer; no detection metrics were given in the abstract
links.quote: In this prognostic study, a proactive, label-agnostic monitoring pipeline detected harmful data shifts for a clinical AI system predicting in-hospital mortality.

design_hint: drift monitoring and triggered continual learning
